Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting pain and limited motion in the right shoulder. The
mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms and the force involved in the crash. Over a course of 21 visits, care
proceeded along a typical rehabilitation pathway, including physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and targeted
strengthening, with visit frequency decreasing as functional gains were achieved. Examination revealed findings that support a
shoulder soft-tissue injury, including pain with resisted movement and reduced range in certain planes, while other orthopedic
and neurological tests returned within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder.
Billing records reflect each service once, without duplicate or repeated charges. Current status shows meaningful improvement,
and the patient is being discharged to a home exercise program with follow-up as needed.
